snippet.title: Black Cat Book Club - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Black Cat Book Club is an idle game about a cat reading all the books in a magic library and learning spells.

📚Keep it on your screen while you work or relax.
🐈‍⬛ Customise your cat and the library.
🔮 Decipher magical languages and cast spells.
